verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Firebase syncs data in real time to connected clients. Firestore supports listening to data, and a community user reports syncing positions to multiple clients at once on the original Firebase database, so shared state could be broadcast through synced records. Nothing in the pack documents presence tracking (connection/disconnect detection) or a dedicated ephemeral broadcast channel. missing for 10: documented presence/online-status tracking, disconnect handling, a non-persistent ephemeral broadcast mechanism, and first-party docs specifically on presence patterns.
